name: Example student car
description: Example of a student-built car (copy of udirc_1610s.json, changed): rear-wheel drive with a locked rear diff (spool), lighter (2S pack), 5000KV motor with a 13:1 gear, softer springs.

geometry_m._sources: Banggood UDIRC 1610S listing (292x225x127 mm, wheelbase/track 180 mm, tyre 85x44.5 mm, clearance 24 mm); udirc.com/products/ud1610s

motor_model._note: Used by the simulated Hall sensor + ESC torque signal (src/sensors.py, src/actuators.py). pole_pairs=2 assumes the usual 4-pole 2845 can (verify on the real motor). kt = 60/(2*pi*KV) = 60/(2*pi*4700). The stock 1610S motor is sensorless; this models a sensored (3x Hall) replacement.
motor_model.name: 2845 4700KV (UDIRC BL2845-47), stock sensorless; Hall sensors assumed for the sim
motor_model._estimates: R line-to-line ~0.012-0.016 ohm scaled (R ~ 1/KV^2) from 2845 siblings; no-load current ~3-4 A from Hobbywing 2840/2850 4700KV (3.1/4.3 A); rotor J ~1e-6 kg m^2 from a ~38 g, 14 mm rotor. None published by UDIRC: measure (VESC detection gives R, L).

battery._note: bundled 3S 11.1 V 2400 mAh XT60 (UDIRC MB-XT2411). cell_voltage is open-circuit (4.2 full, 3.7 nominal). Internal resistance is an estimate for a 50C 2400 mAh pack.

vesc._note: Torque (current) control. command_delay = UART 115200 COMM_SET_CURRENT packet (~0.9 ms on the wire) + comm thread / next control cycle; CAN ~0.25 ms. current_time_constant = VESC Tool FOC detection default tc 1000 us (Kp = L/tc, Ki = R/tc -> ~160 Hz bandwidth). Limits mirror mcconf l_current_max/min (60 A default = stock ESC rating), l_in_current_max/min, l_max_duty 0.95. Source: github.com/vedderb/bldc mcconf_default.h, conf_general.c. Use 3S: VESC default 8 V minimum rules out 2S.

unity_model._note: Unity PhysX car (UnityPhysicsController.cs). Inertia = box placeholder scaled to 1.40 kg (measure: pendulum/CAD). wheel mass from UDIRC spare-part weights (4 wheels+tyres ~276 g). Travel = 18 mm shock stroke x ~1.5 motion ratio. Spring/damper chosen for ~4-5 Hz, zeta ~0.5 (not published). max_steer_deg not published (25-30 typical). motor_axis: longitudinal assumed (spur on the centre shaft); it sets which body axis the rotor's reaction torque acts on. launch_speed: scripted-run speed target (the throttle phase of config/scene.json driver runs in speed mode).
unity_model._mounts: sensor mounts in the body frame (x fwd, y left, z up) from mid-wheelbase on the axle line: accelerometer at the COM, lidar on the front bumper (length/2 ahead, ~7 cm above the ground). Lidar FoV/rate/tilt and sensor noise come from config/scene.json -> sensors.

tire._note: UdircSim tyre model: F = mu N sin(C atan(B s)); s = slip ratio (x) or slip angle in rad (y); friction circle; Unity's WheelCollider only does suspension + contact. Estimates for RC rubber on a hard surface, not measured.
tire._diff: diff_damping: internal friction of the open front/rear diffs, as a torque against the left/right speed difference (N m s/rad). 0 = ideal open diff (one spinning wheel runs away and yaws the car).

unity_model._brakes: brake_torque_fraction caps torque that opposes the motion in speed mode and for the keyboard (RC-ESC-like brake strength); the keyboard reverses at reverse_torque_fraction once stopped. Experiment torque mode stays pure torque (negative = reverse).
unity_model._drivetrain: drivetrain: 4wd (locked centre shaft, the 1610S), rwd or fwd (the other axle rolls free). front_diff / rear_diff: open (equal torque left/right) or locked (spool: both wheels at the same speed); only matters on a driven axle.
